pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sabbapaṃsukūliko susāne viharati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.3: so manussehi dīyamānaṃ na icchati paṭiggahetuṃ. susānepi rukkhamūlepi ummārepi ayyavosāṭitakāni sāmaṃ gahetvā bhuñjati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma ayaṃ bhikkhu amhākaṃ ayyavosāṭitakāni sāmaṃ gahetvā bhuñjissasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.6: theroyaṃ bhikkhu vadharo manussamaṃsaṃ maññe khādatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.8: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āharissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.10: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āharasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.13: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āharissasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.14: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.15: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.16.1: yo pana bhikkhu adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āhareyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.17: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū udakadantapoṇe kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:2.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave udakadantapoṇaṃ sāmaṃ gahetvā bhuñjituṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:2.4: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:2.5.1: yo pana bhikkhu adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āhareyya aññatra udakadantapoṇā pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:3.1.8: kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā nissaggiyena vā dente hatthapāse ṭhito kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā paṭiggaṇhāti etaṃ dinnaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:3.1.10: udakadantapoṇaṃ ṭhapetvā yaṅkiñci ajjhoharaṇīyaṃ eso āhāro nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:3.2.1: appaṭiggahitake appaṭiggahitakasaññī adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āharati aññatra udakadantapoṇā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:3.2.2: appaṭiggahitake vematiko adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āharati aññatra udakadantapoṇā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:3.2.3: appaṭiggahitake paṭiggahitakasaññī adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āharati aññatra udakadantapoṇā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:3.3.3: cattāri mahāvikatāni sati paccaye asati kappiyakārake sāmaṃ gahetvā paribhuñjati
